headline: Profit and revenue growth accelerate sharply year over year
summary_short: Nu Holdings' Q1 FY2026 revenue rose 57.2% y/y to $3,538.3 million and net income grew 56.5% y/y to $872.1 million, though net income slipped 2.3% q/q even as revenue grew 12.8% q/q.
summary_long: Q1 FY2026 revenue reached $3,538.3 million, up 57.2% y/y and 12.8% q/q. Net income of $872.1 million rose 56.5% y/y but fell 2.3% q/q, with diluted EPS of $0.18 (+55.9% y/y) and basic EPS of $0.18 (+55.2% y/y) — EPS growth tracked net income growth closely, implying diluted share count rose only marginally over the year. The only primary filing available for this period is the auditor's Managerial P&L Reconciliation Report (a 6-K exhibit); it contains no MD&A narrative, cause explanations, or forward guidance, so no company-disclosed drivers or guidance could be assessed beyond arithmetic decomposition of the shard's own KPI deltas.

drivers.explanation: Not explained in the release — this filing is an auditor's Independent Limited Assurance Report and Managerial P&L Reconciliation Report, with no MD&A or press-release narrative disclosing causes.
Diluted EPS grew 55.9% y/y, almost exactly tracking net income's 56.5% y/y growth, implying diluted share count rose only marginally (roughly 0.4%) over the year.
Net income fell 2.3% q/q even as revenue rose 12.8% q/q — arithmetically, total costs and taxes grew faster than revenue this quarter; the filing does not decompose why.
